name: Jumping in the City
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: a NEW square Android launcher icon for the parkour game "Jumping in the City".
Input image 1 is the exact game protagonist and is the authoritative reference for his identity, face, hairstyle, clothing, colors, materials and semi-realistic 3D visual style. Recompose this same character into an iconic app-icon design. Preserve his warm tan complexion, youthful ADULT face, dark eyes, thick tousled dark-brown hair, light stubble, charcoal hoodie with sleeves pushed to the forearms and hood DOWN, thin white undershirt hem, charcoal cropped cargo trousers, yellow straps and pocket details, black/yellow wristband, black-and-yellow running sneakers with white midsoles. Do not substitute a different man, outfit, hair or art style.
Design: an immediately recognizable premium MOBILE APP ICON, strong and simple, with ONE huge protagonist in an energetic compact forward parkour leap. Three-quarter FRONT view so the face is clearly recognizable, looking ahead with a confident focused expression, one knee driven up and opposing arm bent naturally, other arm balancing. Athletic believable anatomy. The face, torso and raised knee dominate the design, tightly grouped silhouette. Slight perspective makes the forward movement exciting without huge hands or feet. Head near the upper third, character centered; no tiny full-body figure in a sprawling landscape.
Use the same polished semi-realistic 3D character aesthetic as the reference, clean natural skin and fabric shading, refined sculpted forms. Push graphic clarity by simplifying background and increasing silhouette contrast, NOT by turning him into anime, cartoon or a flat logo.
Backdrop: bold warm amber-yellow sky transitioning subtly to golden yellow, with only three or four large simplified dark blue/teal urban building silhouettes in the lower background. Two minimal dark rooftop ledges along the lower left and lower right suggest the jump across a gap. Architecture subordinate, no detailed sprawling skyline. Controlled golden rim light on the black clothing, clear readable face. A cohesive charcoal, yellow and deep teal palette derived from the protagonist's outfit.
Output: one finished square 1:1 full-bleed opaque image, not a phone mockup. Strong icon readability at 64 pixels; central face and primary silhouette safely inside launcher mask margins. No text, no letters, no title, no logo, no extra characters, no rounded-corner frame, no white outer margins, no watermarks, no orange T-shirt, no photo-real cinematic city panorama, no tiny clutter, no explosive effects. This is a compact visual identity for an app.
